scope_note: A metadata-only catalogue of high-value official HM Land Registry sources. It complements, rather than replaces, the dated GOV.UK Search, GitHub and CDDO catalogue census lanes. URLs, fees, service status, release dates and terms must be rechecked at the publisher before use.

records.title: HM Land Registry
records.description: The official GOV.UK organisation hub for HM Land Registry, which registers ownership of land and property in England and Wales.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to stated exceptions and third-party rights
records.cadence: continuously maintained
caveats: The bundle is independent and does not speak for HM Land Registry.
The remit is England and Wales; UK-wide products state their own coverage.

records.title: Land registration data
records.description: The official GOV.UK collection for HM Land Registry public datasets and related guidance.
records.jurisdiction: England and Wales, with UK-wide coverage where a dataset says so
records.authentication: none for collection metadata; dataset access varies
records.licence: Dataset-specific; do not infer a common licence from collection membership
records.cadence: maintained as datasets change
caveats: Collection publication dates and page updates are not dataset currency dates.
Publisher dataset pages control current cadence, access and licence details.

records.title: HM Land Registry public data
records.description: Official policy explaining which HM Land Registry datasets are open, free under another licence, restricted, shared with the public sector or otherwise available.
records.licence: Page under applicable GOV.UK terms; referenced datasets retain their own licences and third-party rights
records.cadence: updated when policy or products change
caveats: Free access is not the same as open redistribution.
Ordnance Survey, Royal Mail, GeoPlace and other third-party rights may apply.
Recheck the dataset-specific licence before every use or redistribution.

records.title: Use land and property data
records.description: HM Land Registry's publisher-operated catalogue for bulk datasets linked to registered land and property.
records.jurisdiction: England and Wales, with UK-wide coverage for UK HPI reports
records.access_model: mixed: open download, account-and-licence, API and paid products
records.authentication: varies by dataset; some downloads and APIs require an account, accepted licence and API key
records.licence: dataset-specific: Open Government Licence, bespoke, direct-use, exploration or commercial terms
records.cadence: catalogue maintained; individual datasets have independent cadences
caveats: The catalogue showed 14 dataset entries at the research cutoff, but the build must re-enumerate before claiming completeness.
Some files are multi-gigabyte and require specialist tools.
This bundle records metadata only and never downloads the listed property data.

records.title: Price Paid Data
records.description: Transaction-level information about property sales in England and Wales sold for value and lodged for registration, available as monthly, yearly and complete files and through linked data.
records.access_model: public bulk download and public linked-data access
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with required HMLR attribution and additional conditions for third-party address data
records.cadence: monthly, normally on the twentieth working day
caveats: The latest month is incomplete and is added to in later releases.
Registration and publication lag the underlying sale.
It excludes transactions that do not meet the publisher's stated inclusion criteria.
Address fields include Ordnance Survey and Royal Mail rights not fully licensed by the OGL.
The complete file is several gigabytes and is not acquired by this bundle.

records.title: UK House Price Index
records.description: An accredited monthly house-price index and data series produced by HM Land Registry with partner administrations and statistical bodies.
records.publisher: HM Land Registry and UK House Price Index partners
records.jurisdiction: United Kingdom, with nation-specific availability and history
records.access_model: public reports, downloads and report-generation tools
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 subject to the series' stated reuse conditions
records.cadence: monthly
caveats: Recent estimates are provisional and revised as later transactions arrive.
An index is not a valuation of an individual property.
Coverage start dates and methods differ across the four UK nations.
Release month and reference month are different dates.

records.title: Transaction Data
records.description: Five monthly aggregate files describing applications and searches completed by HM Land Registry, grouped by customer or location.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with publisher attribution
records.cadence: monthly, normally on the fifteenth working day for the preceding month
caveats: This measures completed applications and searches, not the live application queue or property market directly.
Pending, bankruptcy and bulk applications are excluded.
Customer-name data reflects account customers and should not be treated as individual performance without context.
Historical files extend to December 2011; classifications and structures need version-aware comparison.

records.title: Request for information (requisition) data
records.description: Quarterly statistics about register-change applications from account-holder customers and the requests for information HM Land Registry sends to them.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with publisher attribution and link to the dataset explanation
records.cadence: quarterly, normally on the fifteenth working day after the quarter
caveats: Requests for information were formerly called requisitions.
Customer activity mix affects counts and prevents simplistic league-table interpretation.
Telephone requests, bankruptcy applications, bulk applications and pending applications are excluded.
The publisher does not guarantee that the dataset is error-free or fit for a particular use.

records.title: Request for information (avoidable requisition) data
records.description: A six-month snapshot of completed register-change applications with requisitions classified as wholly avoidable for account customers meeting the stated activity threshold.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 with publisher attribution and link to the dataset explanation
records.cadence: every six months, normally on the fifteenth working day after the period
caveats: Only customers submitting at least the publisher's threshold number of applications are included.
Requisitions containing both technical and avoidable points are excluded.
The percentage is not an absolute measure of overall requisition performance.
Each release is a new snapshot and is not revised.

records.title: UK companies that own property in England and Wales
records.description: Monthly title-level data for registered land and property whose legal owner is a UK company or corporate body; formerly Commercial and Corporate Ownership Data (CCOD).
records.access_model: free account-and-licence download; authenticated API available
records.authentication: account and accepted dataset licence; API access additionally uses an API key
records.licence: dataset-specific licence containing third-party address-rights conditions
records.cadence: monthly, on the second working day for the preceding month
caveats: This is legal registered ownership by companies, not beneficial ownership.
Private individuals, overseas companies and charities are excluded.
Pending register updates are absent until completed and published.
Historical identifiers and addresses can be incomplete or inconsistent.
Address data carries Ordnance Survey and Royal Mail rights.

records.title: Overseas companies that own property in England and Wales
records.description: Monthly title-level data for registered land and property whose legal owner is a company or corporate body incorporated outside the UK; formerly Overseas Company Ownership Data (OCOD).
records.access_model: free account-and-licence download; authenticated API available
records.authentication: account and accepted dataset licence; API access additionally uses an API key
records.licence: dataset-specific licence containing third-party address-rights conditions
records.cadence: monthly, on the second working day for the preceding month
caveats: This is legal registered ownership by an overseas company, not beneficial ownership.
Private individuals, UK companies with overseas addresses and charities are excluded.
Pending register updates are absent until completed and published.
The data omits records before the publisher's stated historical start.
Address data carries Ordnance Survey and Royal Mail rights.
The publisher page and file identity, not a catalogue or bundle timestamp, establish the stated release cadence and covered month; this dataset is not the live legal register.

records.title: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
records.description: Monthly GML files showing the indicative position and extent of registered freehold property in England and Wales by local authority area.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 plus required HM Land Registry and Ordnance Survey attribution conditions
records.cadence: monthly, on the first Sunday for the preceding month
caveats: Polygons are indicative and do not establish the exact legal extent of a title.
The source GML uses British National Grid (EPSG:27700); reprojection may introduce positional error.
This is a freehold subset, not all registered titles or all land.
A title may have several polygons; local-authority boundary polygons may be duplicated across files.
A missing INSPIRE ID does not prove that land is unregistered.
GIS software is normally required.

records.title: INSPIRE index polygons technical guidance
records.description: Publisher technical guidance for the INSPIRE index polygons GML files, including coordinate reference system, attributes and GIS handling.
records.licence: guidance content terms; the linked dataset retains its stated licence and attribution conditions
records.cadence: maintained with the dataset
caveats: The source GML uses British National Grid (EPSG:27700); reprojection may introduce positional error.
A coordinate reference system does not make an indicative polygon an exact legal boundary.
Use current publisher guidance and inspect the source schema before processing a release.

records.title: Local land charges spatial data (INSPIRE)
records.description: Monthly GML files showing indicative locations of migrated local land charges that fall within specified INSPIRE themes.
records.jurisdiction: England and Wales, limited to migrated local-authority data
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 plus required HM Land Registry and Ordnance Survey attribution conditions
records.cadence: monthly, on the sixth day for the preceding month
caveats: Not every local authority has migrated its local land charges data.
The polygons are indicative; source documents held by the originating authority determine definitive extent.
Only charges in the stated INSPIRE theme groups are represented.
This does not include CON29 enquiries.

records.title: National Polygon Service
records.description: A licensed service combining the National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number and UPRN Look Up datasets for registered freehold and leasehold titles.
records.access_model: paid annual licence with account download and authenticated API
records.authentication: account, executed licence, payment and API key for API access
records.licence: bespoke National Polygon Service licence with Ordnance Survey and GeoPlace rights and attribution
records.cadence: monthly, on the second working day for the preceding month
caveats: The observed annual price was £20,000 plus VAT and must be rechecked before a decision.
Polygons show indicative position and extent, not exact legal boundaries.
A title number can link to a UPRN only where the publisher can establish a relationship to AddressBase.
The files are very large and are not acquired by this bundle.

records.title: Registered Leases
records.description: Monthly licensed data about registered leasehold land and property, including lease dates, terms and selected associated property information.
records.access_model: account-and-licence download and authenticated API; commercial use is paid
records.authentication: account and accepted direct-use, exploration or commercial licence; API key for API access
records.licence: three dataset-specific licence types: direct use, exploration and commercial
records.cadence: monthly, on the sixth working day for the preceding month
caveats: Not every short lease is registrable or registered; scope follows the technical specification.
Direct-use data cannot be published or shared externally under the observed terms.
The observed commercial annual price was £5,000 plus VAT and must be rechecked.
The data is a monthly snapshot, not the live register.

records.title: Restrictive Covenants
records.description: Monthly licensed data indicating registered titles with restrictive covenants, without the text or detail of the covenant itself.
records.access_model: account-and-licence download and authenticated API; commercial use is paid
records.authentication: account and accepted direct-use, exploration or commercial licence; API key for API access
records.licence: three dataset-specific licence types: direct use, exploration and commercial
records.cadence: monthly, on the sixth working day for the preceding month
caveats: The dataset indicates that a covenant exists but does not give its wording or legal effect.
Relevant details may require official registers or documents.
Direct-use data cannot be published or shared externally under the observed terms.
The observed commercial annual price was £475 plus VAT and must be rechecked.
The data is a monthly snapshot, not the live register.

records.title: HM Land Registry Geospatial Data Catalogue
records.description: A small CSV discovery catalogue describing selected electronic HM Land Registry datasets linked to location through title registrations.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0, subject to the catalogue's stated conditions
records.cadence: rarely updated
caveats: The catalogue can be stale relative to publisher dataset pages.
Catalogue timestamps are not dataset currency timestamps.
It covers some, not necessarily all, location-linked HMLR datasets.

records.title: 1862 Act Register
records.description: A static digital representation of the first land register created by HM Land Registry under the Land Registry Act 1862.
records.jurisdiction: Historical register coverage under the 1862 Act
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 subject to the source's stated conditions
records.cadence: static
caveats: This is a historical source, not the current register.
Names and property information may concern historical individuals and require responsible handling.
Image transcription and interpretation can introduce errors.

records.title: Use land and property data API v1
records.description: REST API for authorised discovery of datasets, resource history and short-lived secure download links for five licensed HM Land Registry products.
records.access_model: documentation public; operational API authenticated and licence-gated
records.authentication: account, accepted dataset licence and API key
records.licence: underlying dataset licence controls use; documentation terms may differ
records.cadence: versioned API; dataset resources follow their own release schedules
caveats: The bundle must not call this authenticated API.
Signed download URLs expire and are credentials; never log or publish them.
API availability does not alter dataset licence restrictions.
The five observed API-enabled datasets are CCOD, OCOD, National Polygon Service, Registered Leases and Restrictive Covenants.

records.title: Business Gateway developer pack
records.description: Publisher-operated technical documentation, service definitions, schemas and integration guidance for HM Land Registry Business Gateway products.
records.access_model: public documentation; test and production services restricted
records.authentication: Business e-services approval and product-specific certificate or credentials for operational services
records.licence: service and documentation terms are product-specific
records.cadence: maintained with product and schema releases
caveats: Documentation discovery does not authorise test or production calls.
Public documentation is not permission for anonymous or automated operation.
SOAP/WSDL and REST products have different contracts and must not be conflated.
The publisher pack outranks cross-government API catalogue rows for current operation.

records.title: HM Land Registry linked data
records.description: Official linked-data publishing and query services for Price Paid Data, Transaction Data and UK House Price Index resources.
records.access_model: public query and resource access, subject to service and dataset conditions
records.authentication: none observed for public linked-data routes
records.licence: underlying dataset-specific terms and third-party rights apply
records.cadence: dataset-specific
caveats: The service's live operational status was not fully exercised during discovery.
A public query endpoint is not permission for unbounded extraction.
Dataset models and update semantics differ and must not be merged naively.

records.title: LandRegistry GitHub organisation
records.description: The official public GitHub organisation containing HM Land Registry code, prototypes, documentation and archived repositories.
records.access_model: public repository metadata and source where a repository is public
records.authentication: none for bounded public metadata; GitHub rate limits apply
records.licence: repository-specific; absence of a licence is not permission to reuse code
records.cadence: continuous
caveats: Public code is not necessarily supported or in production.
Archived, fork and prototype status must remain visible.
Each repository licence and security posture must be reviewed independently.

records.title: CDDO API Catalogue — HM Land Registry records
records.description: Cross-government discovery metadata for APIs whose provider field is HM Land Registry.
records.authentication: none for catalogue metadata; listed APIs vary
records.licence: catalogue-repository terms; listed APIs retain their own terms
records.cadence: catalogue maintained independently of API publishers
caveats: The frozen live provider-filtered denominator was 15 rows; an older sibling-bundle seed contained 27.
Rows may lag publisher-operated documentation and can omit licence or authentication details.
A catalogue entry does not establish that an API is live or publicly callable.

records.title: Search for land and property information
records.description: Official route for finding a property summary and buying downloaded copies of title registers, title plans or referred documents.
records.authentication: sign-in required for searches and purchases
records.licence: service terms and statutory access rules; purchased documents are not open-data distributions
records.cadence: live service; guidance and fees change
caveats: The current service page describes mortgage presence only; lender identity and discharge wording must be cited to the separate register guidance route.
Downloaded copies are not proof of ownership and differ from official copies.
A title plan normally shows general boundaries, not exact legal boundaries.
Some land is unregistered, some interests are not registrable and pending applications may not yet appear.
This bundle does not search the service, create an account or buy documents.

records.title: Title register and title summary information
records.description: Official guidance describing information available in the title register and title summary, including mortgage, lender and discharge details.
records.access_model: public-web guidance; linked searches and products may require an account and payment
records.licence: eligible GOV.UK content may be OGL v3.0 subject to exceptions; purchased register products are not open-data distributions
records.cadence: guidance changes with the service
caveats: The title summary may show a lender's name and address when there is a mortgage; the title register may show whether a mortgage has been discharged.
The current property-information service promises only whether the property has a mortgage, so cite this guidance route for lender or discharge wording.
Downloaded online information is not official proof; use the official-copy route where evidential status matters.

records.title: HM Land Registry Property Alert
records.description: A free account service that sends email alerts when specified activity occurs on monitored registered properties.
records.licence: service terms; alerts and property information are not an open dataset
records.cadence: event-driven alerts
caveats: An alert does not block an application or prove fraud.
Users must follow the official response route if an alert is suspicious.
This bundle does not sign in, monitor properties or process alert emails.

records.title: Search for local land charges
records.description: HM Land Registry's statutory Local Land Charges search service for migrated local-authority areas.
records.jurisdiction: England and Wales, limited to migrated local authorities
records.access_model: public search subject to terms and fees
records.licence: service terms, copyright and database-right restrictions
records.cadence: live service with changing authority coverage
caveats: Automated software agents must not search, copy or monitor the service.
Recheck the live terms before use; the public GOV.UK start page is not itself automation permission.
Coverage depends on local-authority migration and must be checked at search time.
CON29 enquiries are separate.
The official result, not this metadata record, controls a transaction.

records.title: Local Land Charges search terms and conditions
records.description: Service-specific terms governing use of HM Land Registry's Local Land Charges search, including the restriction on automated software agents.
records.jurisdiction: England and Wales, limited to migrated local authorities
records.access_model: public terms; operational search subject to service restrictions and fees
records.authentication: none for terms; service-dependent for searches
records.licence: service terms, copyright and database-right restrictions
records.cadence: live terms; recheck before use
caveats: The terms prohibit automated software agents from searching, copying or monitoring the service.
Public access to the terms or start page is not permission for anonymous automation.
Recheck the live terms before use because service conditions can change.

records.title: HM Land Registry portal
records.description: Business e-services portal used by approved professional customers for applications, searches, documents and related land-registration work.
records.authentication: Business e-services credentials and role-specific access
records.licence: portal and Business e-services terms
records.cadence: live service with maintained guidance and roadmap
caveats: Public guidance does not grant portal access.
Fees, available transactions and service behavior can change.
The bundle never signs in or performs a transaction.

records.title: HM Land Registry fee calculator
records.description: Official tool for working out registration-service fees from the transaction and application details supplied by a user.
records.licence: service terms; calculator output is not a substitute for the current Fee Order and guidance
records.cadence: updated when fees or rules change
caveats: A result depends on the user's inputs and current fee rules.
Current formal fee legislation and HM Land Registry guidance control.
The bundle does not reproduce fee calculations.

records.title: Guidance for members of the public
records.description: Audience-oriented routes for common land-registration tasks, including property information, ownership changes, boundaries, fraud and support.
records.authentication: none for guidance; linked services vary
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated as services and practice change
caveats: General guidance is not legal advice.
Complex or disputed matters may require a conveyancer or other qualified adviser.

records.title: Guidance and support for property professionals
records.description: Audience hub for conveyancers, lenders and other professional customers using HM Land Registry guidance and services.
records.access_model: public guidance with links to restricted professional services
records.authentication: none for guidance; linked services require approval or accounts
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated as services and practice change
caveats: Service eligibility and account requirements vary.
Use the latest practice guide, notice and service documentation for an actual application.

records.title: Land registration practice guides
records.description: The official collection of detailed HM Land Registry practice guidance for conveyancers and other legal professionals.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: individual guides updated as law and practice change
caveats: The guides are principally written for legal professionals.
Each guide has its own update history and may have a Welsh representation.
Current legislation and formal notices control where there is a conflict.

records.title: HM Land Registry forms
records.description: Official GOV.UK collection of forms used in land-registration applications and related processes.
records.authentication: none for forms; digital submission services may require accounts
records.licence: Crown copyright and source-specific reuse terms
records.cadence: forms revised when law, policy or process changes
caveats: Always use the current publisher version of a form.
A form alone does not explain eligibility, evidence, fees or submission requirements.
Some PDF forms may present accessibility barriers; check for alternative formats.

records.title: HM Land Registry: Registration Services fees
records.description: Official guidance on fees for registration services and the fee scale applying to different application routes.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated when the Fee Order or service routes change
caveats: Fee rules are time-sensitive and transaction-specific.
Check the current Fee Order, guidance and calculator before submitting an application.

records.title: HM Land Registry processing times
records.description: Official guidance reporting expected and recent completion times for categories of applications and information services.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: regularly updated
caveats: Published times are operational estimates or distributions, not a guarantee for an individual case.
Complexity, requisitions and expedition decisions affect actual completion.

records.title: HM Land Registry Local Land Charges Programme
records.description: Official programme information about migration of local-authority Local Land Charges registers to HM Land Registry and the national search service.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated as authorities migrate and programme policy changes
caveats: Authority coverage changes and must be checked at the point of search.
Planned transfer dates are forecasts, not evidence of completed migration.
The national service does not include CON29 enquiries.

records.title: HM Land Registry personal information charter
records.description: Official explanation of how HM Land Registry handles personal information in the register, applications, services and organisational activities.
records.jurisdiction: United Kingdom data-protection context; operational remit England and Wales
records.licence: GOV.UK content terms; personal information remains subject to data-protection and statutory rules
records.cadence: updated when processing or law changes
caveats: Statutory public access to register information does not make all personal data open data.
The bundle excludes title, ownership, address, application and user-generated personal records.

records.title: HM Land Registry accessible documents policy
records.description: Official policy describing known accessibility limitations in published documents and how to request alternative formats.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: reviewed as publishing practice changes
caveats: Some source PDFs and office documents are not fully accessible.
The bundle should expose HTML metadata and source alternative-format routes rather than republishing inaccessible attachments.

records.title: HM Land Registry customer help
records.description: Official support and contact routes for common HM Land Registry questions and service issues.
records.access_model: public help pages and contact routes
records.licence: service and content terms; user-generated forum content is excluded
records.cadence: continuously maintained
caveats: Forum posts can contain user-supplied personal or sensitive information.
The bundle records only top-level help routes and excludes forum posts, profiles and uploads.
Support responses do not replace formal legal advice.

records.title: HM Land Registry blog
records.description: Official explanatory posts about land registration, data, digital services, policy and organisational work.
records.licence: GOV.UK blog terms and article-specific third-party rights
records.cadence: irregular
caveats: Blog posts provide context but do not replace current formal guidance, legislation or service terms.
The initial bundle does not claim a complete blog-post census.

records.title: HM Land Registry Strategy 2025+
records.description: Current corporate strategy setting out HM Land Registry's strategic direction, public value and transformation priorities.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: strategy-period publication with updates or replacement
caveats: Strategic intent is not evidence that every planned capability is delivered.
Use current business plans and reports to assess implementation.

records.title: HM Land Registry Business Plan 2026+
records.description: The current business plan translating Strategy 2025+ into 2026–27 outcomes, key performance indicators, risk and financial priorities.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: annual or plan-period publication
caveats: Targets and milestones are time-bounded to the plan period.
The plan describes intentions; annual reports and official statistics provide outcome evidence.

records.title: HM Land Registry annual reports and accounts
records.description: Official reports on HM Land Registry's yearly performance, governance, finances, risks and audited accounts.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: annual
caveats: Financial years and publication years differ.
Figures and narrative should be read with the report's audit status, definitions and comparators.

records.title: HM Land Registry publication scheme
records.description: Official guide to routinely published organisational information and routes for information requests.
records.jurisdiction: United Kingdom freedom-of-information context; operational remit England and Wales
records.licence: GOV.UK content terms; underlying publications retain their own rights
records.cadence: reviewed as publication practice changes
caveats: A publication scheme is an access map, not a complete page-level catalogue.
Statutory information-request exemptions and fees may apply.

records.title: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (PG40 supplement 3)
records.description: Official practice guidance on how title plans show general boundaries and how general, agreed and determined boundaries differ.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated when land-registration practice changes
caveats: A title-plan line normally shows a general boundary, not the exact legal boundary.
Practice guidance does not decide a particular dispute or replace legal advice.

records.title: Portal official copies and searches of the index map
records.description: Official portal guidance for requesting official copies and, when an address search is insufficient, finding titles through a search of the index map.
records.access_model: public guidance with links to an approved professional account service
records.authentication: none for guidance; approved account required for portal operation
records.licence: GOV.UK content terms; portal products and operation have separate conditions
records.cadence: updated as portal workflows change
caveats: The bundle does not operate the portal or authorise a search.
Official copies, ordinary online downloads and index-map searches are distinct products and procedures.

records.title: Land and property ownership data collection
records.description: Cross-government discovery collection whose catalogue modification dates must not be confused with an HMLR dataset release date, register update or legal currency.
records.publisher: Government Digital Service and contributing publishers
records.licence: catalogue and record-specific; underlying publisher terms control reuse
records.cadence: catalogue-maintained
caveats: Catalogue modification time is not dataset release, registration or legal currency.
Publisher-operated HMLR pages control current access, licence and operational facts.

records.title: Use land and property data accessibility statement
records.description: Service-specific statement covering keyboard, focus, map, language and WCAG accessibility limitations for the HMLR data catalogue.
records.licence: service content terms; linked datasets retain separate rights
records.cadence: reviewed as the service changes
caveats: Some Welsh place names in INSPIRE are not coded as a different language and may be mispronounced by screen readers; this source defect is not permission for the bundle to omit language metadata.
The source service's statement does not establish accessibility of this bundle.
The statement reported partial WCAG 2.2 AA compliance at the observation date.
The live statement was last reviewed on 26 September 2024 and reports September 2024 testing; January 2025 remediation targets are past, so current remediation status is unknown without retesting.
Recheck the live statement for remediation and contact information.

records.title: HM Land Registry Welsh Language Scheme
records.description: Official scheme for Welsh-language and bilingual HM Land Registry services, publications and public interactions.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated when the language scheme changes
caveats: Welsh availability is service- and publication-specific; do not infer that every linked item is bilingual.
Preserve the source-native language identity instead of merging Welsh and English content.

records.title: HM Land Registry Welsh Language Scheme publication
records.description: The published Welsh Language Scheme describing HM Land Registry's commitments for Welsh and bilingual services, correspondence, publications and register contexts.
records.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 for eligible GOV.UK content, subject to exceptions
records.cadence: updated when the language scheme changes
caveats: The scheme is not proof that every HM Land Registry service, register entry or publication is bilingual.
Preserve explicit English and Welsh language identity and recheck the current scheme before relying on a service commitment.

records.title: Land Registration Act 2002
records.description: Primary legislation establishing the modern legal framework for registration of title to land in England and Wales.

records.cadence: revised text changes as amendments take effect
caveats: Check whether viewing original, revised or prospective text and the date to which changes are incorporated.
Legislation is not legal advice and must be read with applicable rules and case law.

records.title: Land Registration Rules 2003
records.description: Principal procedural rules made under the Land Registration Act 2002, as amended.
records.licence: Crown copyright and legislation.gov.uk reuse terms
records.cadence: revised text changes as amendments take effect
caveats: The rules have been amended; verify the relevant version and effective date.
Procedural guidance may explain practice but cannot override the rules.

records.title: Local Land Charges Act 1975
records.description: Primary legislation governing local land charges and the statutory register, as amended.
records.licence: Crown copyright and legislation.gov.uk reuse terms
records.cadence: revised text changes as amendments take effect
caveats: Check revised text and commencement or migration provisions applicable to the relevant authority.
